encounters.cc: Progressive fatigue, generalized muscle weakness, and intermittent muscle cramps

lines: Progressive fatigue, generalized muscle weakness, and intermittent muscle cramps

The patient is a 46-year-old female with hypertension secondary to primary hyperaldosteronism who returns for follow-up, having been seen in Internal Medicine two months prior for cardiovascular risk assessment.
She reports difficulty carrying grocery bags and climbing stairs due to leg weakness.
She works as an accountant and has recently noticed feeling lightheaded when standing up quickly, though denies palpitations, chest pain, or syncope.
She mentions that her blood pressure readings at home are "always on the high side" despite reducing salt intake.
Her medical history includes borderline hypertension diagnosed three years ago, for which she has not been taking any medications.

- Cabergoline 0.5 mg PO twice weekly (patient non-compliant)
She does not smoke, drink alcohol, or use recreational drugs.

Neurological examination reveals decreased deep tendon reflexes in the lower extremities.
Cardiopulmonary and abdominal examinations are normal.

encounters.cc: Six-month history of persistent vulvar itching and discomfort

lines: Six-month history of persistent vulvar itching and discomfort

This 46-year-old female with systemic lupus erythematosus and history of vulvar lichen planus, seen recently in Endocrinology for hyperaldosteronism, presents to clinic with 6-month history of vulvar itching and discomfort.
She reports symptoms are persistent and have progressively worsened.
She has tried over-the-counter antifungal creams without relief.
Her past medical history is significant for hypertension, which is well-controlled with hydrochlorothiazide.
- Wide local excision with sentinel lymph node biopsy of right lower leg melanoma
- Cabergoline 0.5 mg PO twice weekly (patient non-compliant)
- Father: Hypertension, hyperlipidemia, coronary artery disease
She denies any new sexual partners.
On physical examination, you note multiple glazed, erythematous erosions on the vulva bordered by white, lacy striae.
Vaginal examination reveals similar lesions on the vaginal mucosa.
An oral examination shows white, reticulated patches on the buccal mucosa.

encounters.cc: Two-month history of palpable neck mass

lines: Two-month history of palpable neck mass

She reports no pain, dysphagia, or changes in her voice.
Her past medical history is significant for hypertension, which is well-controlled with hydrochlorothiazide.
- Wide local excision with sentinel lymph node biopsy of right lower leg melanoma
She does not take any other medications
- Cabergoline 0.5 mg PO twice weekly (patient non-compliant)
She has no known drug allergies.
- Father: Hypertension, hyperlipidemia, coronary artery disease
Alcohol: Occasional (1 glass of wine on weekends).
On physical examination, a solitary, non-tender, 2 cm nodule is palpable in the right lobe of the thyroid.
There are no signs of cervical lymphadenopathy.
The rest of the examination is unremarkable.
A thyroid ultrasound shows a solitary, hyperechoic, 2 cm nodule in the right thyroid lobe with increased intranodular blood flow.

encounters.cc: Evaluation of changing pigmented skin lesion on right lower leg

lines: Evaluation of changing pigmented skin lesion on right lower leg
The patient returns for dermatology follow-up with history of melanoma and vulvar lichen planus.
She reports that the lesion has been present for several years but has recently increased in size and changed in color.
She denies any pain but mentions occasional itching.
- Wide local excision with sentinel lymph node biopsy of right lower leg melanoma
- Cabergoline 0.5 mg PO twice weekly (patient non-compliant)
- Father: Hypertension, hyperlipidemia, coronary artery disease
Alcohol: Occasional (1 glass of wine on weekends).
On examination, the lesion is 8 mm in diameter, with an asymmetrical shape, irregular borders, and multiple colors including brown, black, and a hint of blue.
It is not tender to palpation.
There are no similar lesions noted elsewhere on her body.
The rest of the skin examination is unremarkable. and the remainder of the physical examination is within normal limits.

encounters.cc: Three-month history of palpable neck mass with recent onset of diarrhea

lines: Three-month history of palpable neck mass with recent onset of diarrhea
The patient returns for evaluation of a neck mass in the context of known medullary thyroid carcinoma and prior toxic thyroid nodule assessment in 2021.
She denies any pain, dysphagia, or changes in her voice.
Her medical history is significant for hypertension, which is well-controlled with hydrochlorothiazide.
- Wide local excision with sentinel lymph node biopsy of right lower leg melanoma
- Cabergoline 0.5 mg PO twice weekly (patient non-compliant)
- Father: Hypertension, hyperlipidemia, coronary artery disease
Alcohol: Occasional (1 glass of wine on weekends).
On physical examination, a firm, non-tender nodule is palpated in the central aspect of her neck.
The rest of the examination is unremarkable.
An ultrasound of the neck shows a 2 cm nodule in the thyroid gland with microcalcifications and irregular margins.
Fine-needle aspiration cytology is consistent with medullary thyroid cancer.

lines: Sudden onset left flank pain and gross hematuria

She mentions that she has been feeling more fatigued over the past few weeks and has noticed some swelling in her legs.
She has a history of systemic lupus erythematosus and was diagnosed with nephrotic syndrome 2 years ago.
- Wide local excision with sentinel lymph node biopsy of right lower leg melanoma
- Cabergoline 0.5 mg PO twice weekly (patient non-compliant)
- Father: Hypertension, hyperlipidemia, coronary artery disease
Alcohol: Occasional (1 glass of wine on weekends).
On physical examination, her blood pressure is 145/90 mmHg, pulse is 88 beats per minute, and she is afebrile.
Her left flank is tender to palpation. There is no costovertebral angle tenderness.

lines: Sudden onset severe thunderclap headache with nausea and visual changes

Her past medical history is significant for hypertension and a prolactinoma for which she has been non-compliant with her dopamine agonist therapy.
